fields.description: A vendor contract's status becomes "Expiring Soon" and the first expiry alert is sent to the assigned Procurement Officer this many days before its end date.
fields.label: Expiring Soon threshold (days before expiry)

fields.description: A second, escalation alert is sent this many days before expiry if the contract still hasn't been renewed, terminated, or superseded. Must be smaller than the threshold above.
fields.label: Escalation alert (days before expiry)
